typography.instructions: Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Enforce tracking-tight on all headers above text-2xl.

visual enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism / Technical Look. Deep black backgrounds, stark white text, 1px solid white/10 borders.
effects: Subtle noise overlay (grain texture) on the main background.
Tracing Beam (Aceternity style) around active channel items or active workflow steps.
Terminal-style progress loaders (e.g., [======    ] 60%) to simulate AI agent tasks.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky nav/header: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-1. Used for the app interface (e.g., col-span-3 for sidebar, col-span-9 for main demo area).

layouts.page_structure: Left sidebar for Enterprise Channels (Finance, Legal, etc.), Main wide area for the Ahi Demo Workspace.
layouts.workspace_structure: Top bar inside workspace for the 9 existing product tabs. Content area below displays the active tab's scenario-specific mocked UI.
layouts.mobile_behavior: Stack the channel selector on top as a horizontal scrollable row or a dropdown on mobile, keeping the demo workspace below it.

motion.channel_switch: framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' with subtle fade and y-axis slide (10px) to indicate context shift.
motion.task_simulation: Staggered fade-ins for log items. Progress bars that animate width from 0% to 100% over 2-3 seconds using linear easing to simulate processing.
motion.active_tab: framer-motion layoutId='activeTabIndicator' for the underline on the selected tab.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against #0A0A0A meets APCA standards. Use #A1A1AA for secondary text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='channel-selector-finance').

media.icons: lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5 for a crisp, technical feel)

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific data-dense dashboard simulation to maintain extreme performance and focus on the UI workflow.

image urls.description: Abstract black background with wavy lines for the hero section or main wrapper.
Dark teal wavy shapes on black for secondary sections or feature highlights.

mock_data_strategy.behavior: When a channel is clicked, update the `activeChannel` state. The 9 existing tabs render content derived from a dictionary mapped to `activeChannel`. Include an elegant 'SIMULATED WORKFLOW' badge (e.g., a pulsing green or white dot).
mock_data_strategy.simulation: Each tab shows a 'processing' state before revealing the final mocked data. Use Framer Motion to animate progress bars and skeleton loaders to simulate agentic work. Example: 'Agent navigating... extracting... done.' followed by the data display.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the data structures for the Enterprise Channels in a separate file (e.g., src/data/enterpriseChannels.js). Provide distinct mocked data for each of the 9 tabs for every channel.
Implement the layout with pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing wrapper, but use heavily customized Shadcn components for the dashboard internals (Tabs, Cards, ScrollArea, Progress).
Ensure all files created are .js, NOT .tsx.
Use framer-motion for the simulated AI processing states.
Do not rename the existing 9 Ahi tabs. Use the exact ones currently implemented.
Inject the background texture image heavily darkened (e.g., via a pseudo-element with bg-black/80 overlay) to add subtle depth to the marketing sections.
Ensure no completely transparent backgrounds behind text. Use solid #0A0A0A or #141414.
The Channel selector must be distinct from the 9 product tabs to avoid hierarchy confusion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
